instructions_to_main_agent: Build a modern e-learning platform with a Swiss & High-Contrast aesthetic. Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and Satoshi for body. Implement via Google Fonts or Fontshare links in index.html.
Implement JWT auth for students (login/register) and basic mocked admin role.
Student Dashboard must display a Welcome banner, Course Progress % (linear bar), Remaining Time For Today, Total Watched Time (MTO 20-hour tracker), and Modules Completed count.
Render the 8 modules as a bento-style grid or clean card list. Cards should feel tactile (1px border, soft shadow, scale on hover).
For the Module Slide Viewer, create a cinematic video-player-like UI. Dark background, PREV/NEXT buttons, audio narration controls (mocked), slide counter, and a progress bar at the top.
Quiz cards and Final Test card should cleanly show status (Eligible/Not Eligible, Attempted/Unattempted) and Total Score %.
Homework section should list 8 dark module cards showing Status: Incomplete/Complete.
Include a 'Continue From Where You Left Off' sticky bar at the bottom of the screen if a module is in progress.
Add an Admin panel to manage students and view their progress in a data table.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
